bbmp_buzz: Jeskola Buzz (.bmx) songs that use only BmxPlay's machines.
buzz_engine.c and engine.h: github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp csrc/pc, commit 19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7, unchanged.
  License GPL-3.0-or-later (SPDX line in each file, COPYING). This is the licence of the vendored tree as a whole.
bmxplay.h, bmxmi.h, bmxmlist.h, bmxdebug.h, _303.h, _delay.h, _filter.h, _voice.h, _xi.h: BmxPlay 0.4.6 by Joric^Proxium,
  github.com/joric/bmxplay commit e77f921f35caf075876d676a87cc84161b132416, src/. README of that repo: "Player is public domain".
  Only these player headers are vendored. MachineInterface.h (Oskari Tammelin, freeware / non-commercial only) and the machine
  .cpp files that include it are NOT vendored and not needed (the player never includes or links them).
Patches to BmxPlay, the same ones as bbmp tools/build-pc.sh makes (each marked "modland" in the source):
  bmxplay.h: the Windows/Linux waveout include replaced by "#define BUFSIZE 4096" (no sound output).
  bmxmi.h: bmx_alloc zeroed with 16 bytes of room (_xi reads one byte past 4-bit samples, _filter uses state early);
           BmxMachineHeader laid out with pack(8) on Apple (ARM linker cannot place pointers at odd addresses).
  _xi.h: a sample playing backwards past its start (ping-pong) no longer reads before the data.
  _delay.h: delay length clamped to 128/128 of its buffer (a byte in the file).
Engine limit: only songs whose machines are _303, _xi, _voice, _filter, _delay play; any other machine is refused by name.
Global state: the engine keeps one song in static variables, so only one buzz song can be open at a time.
